source: USGS Mars Global Digital Dune Database (MGD³), Hayward et al. 2007, USGS Open-File Report 2007-1158
frame: Planetocentric latitude, east longitude −180…180°, Mars 2000 (as in the Geocentric shapefile)
method: Dune fields outlined on 100 m/px THEMIS IR images, verified with THEMIS VIS and MOC NA where available, at about 1:75,000. Smallest fields ~1 km².
completeness: The database excludes all small dune fields and some moderate-to-large ones (incomplete THEMIS daytime coverage and 100 m/px resolution). The absence of a mapped field does not mean that no dunes exist.
